released_example_1.title: Released example dialogue 1 (first 25 s)
released_example_1.how: Generated by the authors' F-Actor release with the instructions in example_dialogues/instructions_for_example_1_2_3.txt; stereo, left = speaker 1, right = speaker 2. Not generated by us.

tts_request_music.title: Tom's request, TTS: 'Please listen carefully and repeat the word music.'
tts_request_music.how: Synthetic. CosyVoice zero-shot voice cloning from the Behavior-SD reference voice 'tom'. Used as the first turn of every prefix; before it enters the model it gets +5.6 dB and is encoded with NanoCodec (see section 5).

tts_reply_music_raw.title: Gweneth's reply 'Okay, music.', raw TTS
tts_reply_music_raw.how: Synthetic. CosyVoice zero-shot voice cloning from the reference voice 'gweneth'. Note the long lead-in before 'okay' and the pause at the comma.

tts_reply_music_tidy.title: The same reply after tidy_clip
tts_reply_music_tidy.how: Computed here, deterministically, from the raw clip above by training/prefix.py tidy_clip (lead-in cut to 0.1 s, word gaps shortened to <= 0.2 s, 40 ms fade-out), the setting make_dataset.py uses for training replies. No model involved.

base_water.title: Released F-Actor continuing Tom's request ('water')
base_water.how: Released checkpoint, no fine-tuning; prefix = Tom's request only, 0.3 s tail, training prompt format, 150 frames. Ended by max_length after 149 generated frames (80 ms each). Stereo: left = Tom (speaker 1), right = Gweneth (speaker 2); the first 3.4 s is the teacher-forced prefix (TTS request, tail 0.3 s), the rest is generated.

tuned_water.title: micro_v2 LoRA model, same prefix: stops at once
tuned_water.how: LoRA r16 (micro_v2, 5 words), merged. Same prefix and settings as the base clip. Ended by eos after 1 generated frames (80 ms each). Stereo: left = Tom (speaker 1), right = Gweneth (speaker 2); the first 3.4 s is the teacher-forced prefix (TTS request, tail 0.3 s), the rest is generated.

tuned_mask_water.title: micro_v2 LoRA model with the stop mask
tuned_mask_water.how: As above but audio EOS and text-pad forbidden for the first 60 generated frames (mask_stop_frames), 0.1 s tail + 1.5 s look-ahead. Ended by max_length after 149 generated frames (80 ms each). Stereo: left = Tom (speaker 1), right = Gweneth (speaker 2); the first 3.1 s is the teacher-forced prefix (TTS request, tail 0.1 s), the rest is generated.

heads_moon.title: single_v1 Run B (LoRA + heads) on the validation word 'moon'
heads_moon.how: LoRA r16 plus trainable audio embeddings/heads, trained on 69 single-exchange dialogues; prefix with 0.5 s tail. Ended by eos after 84 generated frames (80 ms each). Stereo: left = Tom (speaker 1), right = Gweneth (speaker 2); the first 4.9 s is the teacher-forced prefix (TTS request, tail 0.5 s), the rest is generated.

oov_schadenfreude.title: OOV probe: 'schadenfreude' (released F-Actor, no prefix)
oov_schadenfreude.how: Generated by the released checkpoint from the explainer/listener narratives (Tom explains the word to Brian); config in outputs/oov/schadenfreude_r1.json. Stereo: left = Tom, right = Brian. First 20 s.
